Class Vehicle

java.lang.Object
parking.Vehicle
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Vehicle>, Observer
Direct Known Subclasses:
Pickup, Sedan, Van
public abstract class Vehicle extends Object implements Observer, Comparable<Vehicle>
Abstract class that represents a vehicle registered for parking. A vehicle is uniquely identified by its license plate, keeps its parking history, and receives the system notifications as an observer. The parking fee depends on the vehicle type defined by the subclasses.

    • dayFee

      private static int dayFee(long minutes, int hourlyRate, int dailyRate)
      Calculate the fee for the parking time within a single day. Each started hour is charged by the hourly rate; the daily rate is charged if the parking time exceeds 6 hours.
      Parameters:
      minutes - the number of minutes parked in the day.
      hourlyRate - the hourly rate of the vehicle type.
      dailyRate - the daily rate of the vehicle type.
      Returns:
      the fee for the day.

    • parkingFee

      protected int parkingFee(Deck deck, Timestamp enter, Timestamp exit, int hourlyRate, int dailyRate)
      Calculate the parking fee with the given hourly and daily rates. Each day before the exit day is charged by the daily rate; the time on the exit day is counted from the opening time of the deck. A parking activity within a single day is counted from the entry time.
      Parameters:
      deck - the deck where the vehicle parked.
      enter - the timestamp when the vehicle entered the deck.
      exit - the timestamp when the vehicle exited the deck.
      hourlyRate - the hourly rate of the vehicle type.
      dailyRate - the daily rate of the vehicle type.
      Returns:
      the parking fee.
